title: Workspace settings
description: Manage workspace identity, access and lifecycle using server-enforced controls.

general.title: General
general.description: Update the name shown to members and the canonical workspace URL.
general.readOnlyDescription: Only workspace owners and admins can change the name or URL.
general.savedDescription: The workspace identity and canonical URL are up to date.
general.name: Workspace name
general.nameInvalid: Enter a workspace name between 2 and 120 characters.
general.slugHint: Use 3–30 lowercase letters, numbers or internal hyphens.
general.slugInvalid: Enter a valid, available workspace URL.
general.languageHint: Caselog currently provides one consistent English product vocabulary.
general.slugChangeDescription: After a successful change, Caselog redirects this page to the new workspace URL. Existing reserved redirects prevent another workspace from claiming a previous URL.

members.title: Members
members.description: Review membership, issue invitations and manage access within the server-enforced role hierarchy.
members.readOnlyDescription: All members can review active and inactive access. Only owners and admins can manage roles and invitations.
members.emptyActiveDescription: This workspace currently has no active membership records.
members.emptyInactiveDescription: Deactivated memberships remain visible here for attributable recovery.

success.title: Workspace access updated
success.role: The member role has been updated.
success.state: The member lifecycle state has been updated.
success.ownership: Ownership was transferred and your workspace access was refreshed.
success.invited: The invitation was created and delivery was requested.
success.resent: The invitation token was rotated and delivery was requested again.

confirmDeactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
confirmDeactivate.message: The member immediately loses workspace access and every active API token they created is revoked. Reactivation does not restore those tokens.

invite.title: Invite a workspace member
invite.description: Caselog sends an opaque, expiring link. No raw invitation token is returned to this screen.
invite.emailInvalid: Enter a valid recipient email address.
invite.roleHint: Admins cannot invite another admin; the server enforces the same hierarchy.
invite.permissionDescription: Workspace invitations contain access decisions and are visible only to owners and admins.
invite.emptyDescription: Invite a member when another person needs access to this workspace.
invite.confirmRevokeMessage: The current opaque link stops working immediately. You can issue a new invitation later.

ownership.title: Transfer ownership to {{name}}?
ownership.description: Ownership is a singleton workspace role. This confirmed operation changes both memberships atomically.
ownership.newOwner: The selected active member becomes the workspace owner.
ownership.formerOwner: Your own role changes from owner to admin.
ownership.audited: The complete transition is recorded in the immutable audit log.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Review immutable, server-recorded workspace activity in reverse chronological order.
audit.filterHint: Use a server action such as workspace.updated or member.role_updated.
audit.filterInvalid: Enter a dot-separated lowercase action name.
audit.emptyDescription: Server-recorded workspace actions will appear here.
audit.noMatchesDescription: No recorded action matches this exact filter.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.description: Create narrowly scoped credentials for CI and external automation. Active tokens inherit the creator's current workspace access.
tokens.emptyDescription: Create a scoped token when CI or another trusted automation client needs workspace access.
tokens.confirmRevokeMessage: This credential stops authenticating immediately. The secret cannot be restored and existing automation must receive a replacement token.

form.title: New API token
form.name: Token name
form.nameInvalid: Enter a token name between 1 and 100 characters.
form.expiryHint: Choose a future time no more than 366 days away.
form.expiryInvalid: Choose a valid future expiry within 366 days.
form.scopesHint: Grant only the operations this automation requires.
form.scopesInvalid: Select at least one API token scope.

secret.title: Save the token for {{name}}
secret.description: Copy this secret now and store it in your CI secret manager. Caselog stores only its hash and cannot display it again.
secret.copyConfirmed: The token was copied to the clipboard.
secret.copyFailed: Clipboard access is unavailable. Select and copy the token manually.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.description: Destructive workspace actions require explicit owner confirmation.
danger.loadErrorTitle: Unable to load workspace lifecycle settings
danger.ownerOnlyDescription: Admins and other members can review this policy, but only the workspace owner can delete the workspace.
danger.deleteDescription: Deleting {{name}} invalidates every member's access immediately. The workspace then enters a 30-day recovery window before permanent purge.
danger.recoveryDescription: A deleted workspace appears in the workspace selector until its recovery deadline. An owner can restore it there; after the deadline, background purge is irreversible.
